quotes.text: a provider who considers that such a system does not belong to the placeholder category shall document that assessment before the system is placed on the market
a placeholder risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained
the persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with a placeholder system

statements.text: This article sets out how a system is assigned to a category; whether a CV-screening tool is covered by it is a question for a qualified person.
If the system were found to fall in that category, this article describes a risk management process that may be worth reading.
The tool includes a chat interface for candidates, so the provision on telling people they are interacting with an AI system may be worth reading.
Screening tools are widely used in recruitment.
